splits.development: col000 no-break channel of each of 6 datasets (6 streams), as supplied in cache
splits.evaluation: col001 through col006 of each of 6 datasets, each of three scenarios
splits.warning: Development and evaluation share dataset families/time sources; channel disjoint only, not independent domain holdout.
splits.amendment: Before any metric run, cache enumerator found only 6 col000 cases; no col000 injected-break caches. Amended from intended 18 to available 6 unperturbed development streams; no test metrics were inspected.

scorecaster: causal 300-point rolling OLS AR(1), fit only scores observed strictly before prediction; phi clamped to [-0.95,0.95]
selected_by: development macro average of within-stream normalized Winkler score on six unperturbed col000 channels; tie-break lower eta then KI
primary_evaluation: within-stream interval_score ratio versus ACI(0.05) and BRCP
secondary_evaluation: CD100 on 120-step injected break windows; window [tau,tau+100), no second boundary
interpretation: PID with independently trained AR(1) scorecaster using published P + saturating I + scorecasting architecture; not source-identical author's ThetaModel implementation; no original zero-shot-disjointness claim
